newsitem.title: JAPAN: Economic recovery stalling - Japan bankers' chief.
newsitem.headline: Economic recovery stalling - Japan bankers' chief.

text.p: Japan's economic recovery is stalling to some extent, Federation of Bankers' Associations of Japan chairman Shunsaki Hashimoto said on Tuesday.
He told a regular news conference that he expects the trend of economic recovery to remain intact, but added: "Taking into account recent economic indicators, the recovery is stalling somewhat."
Hashimoto said that recent employment indicators clearly showed a recovery in the job market, which is a bright factor for the economy.

However, he said the Bank of Japan's quarterly "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment released in August showed that business sentiment among major manufacturers, industrial material makers in particular, was undermined because of a delay in inventory adjustments.
